conventions.category: Normal=Act Event（普通事件，仅限单一 Act）; Shrine=神龛（每 Act 可再遇）; One-Time=一次性事件（每局一次）; Unmarked=特殊（Neow，局首）
conventions.ascension: 文本中 'A<N>: X' 表示 wiki 原文的 {{Asc|N|X}} 模板（进阶 N 档）
conventions.options: result 为 wiki Options 区清理后的原文；asc_notes 为含进阶数值的句子摘录
conventions.zh_source: zh 字段来源：'project'=本项目内容层，非 wiki

meta.coverage: Act 1-3 全部普通事件 31 个 + 神龛 6 个（Golden Shrine/Match and Keep/Purifier/Transmogrifier/Upgrade Shrine/Wheel of Change）+ 一次性事件 14 个 + Neow（局首，Unmarked），共 52 条。事件类型/Act 归属按 wiki Events 总表与各事件页原文。act=all 表示 wiki 原文 'all Acts / encountered in any Act'；数组表示多个 Act。combat 字段为按 wiki 页面原文整理的战斗事件信息（非逐字引用）。options 的 result 为 wiki Options 区清理后的原文；[[...]] 链接与 {{TS|...}}} 样式模板已转为纯文本，{{Asc|N|X}} 渲染为 'X (A N)' 或 '(A N: X)'。

events.name: Cursed Tome

options.label: Continue
options.result: Lose 1 HP.

options.label: Continue
options.result: Lose 2 HP.

options.label: Continue
options.result: Lose 3 HP.

options.label: Take
options.result:
Obtain the book. Lose 10 (15) HP.
* The book may be Enchiridion, Nilry's Codex, or Necronomicon. The player does not know which book they will get until after they choose [Take] and lose their HP.

options.label: Stop
options.result: Lose 3 HP.

options.label: Leave
options.result:
Nothing happens.
Practical Options
Because the player can choose to leave the event immediately and lose 0 HP instead of selecting [Continue] 3 times and then backing out with [Stop] while losing a total of 9 HP, there are really only 2 practical ways to navigate the event. The player can either commit to all the HP loss and obtain the book, or leave immediately to do nothing.
For simplicity, the event's options can be thought of in this way instead:
* [Read], then all 3 [Continue], and finally [Take] Obtain the book. Lose 16 (21) HP. 
* [Leave] Nothing happens.

events.text:
In an abandoned temple, you find a giant book, open, riddled with cryptic writings. 
As you try to interpret the elaborate script, it begins to shift and morph into writing you are familiar with.
events.intro: Cursed Tome is an Event found exclusively in Act 2.
events.notes:
* Tungsten Rod will reduce the HP lost for each instance of damage from the event's options. If the player selects [Continue] 3 times and then [Take], Tungsten Rod reduces the total HP lost by 4 for a total of 12 (17) (A15) HP lost instead of 16 (21) (A15).
** If the player selects [Stop] instead of [Take], Tungsten Rod reduces the total HP lost to 5 instead of 9.

events.name: Dead Adventurer

options.label: Search
options.result:
Find Loot. 25% (35%) (A15): monster returns.
* Each [Search] attempt will either cause an Act 1 Elite to return and fight the player, or yield one of the following rewards:
** 30 Gold
** A random Relic
** Nothing
* Each reward only occurs once - if the player's first search found nothing and the second search found the Relic, the third search will either reward 30 Gold or start a battle.
* Each reward that is acquired before fighting the Elite will be removed from its combat rewards if the player eventually does fight the Elite and defeats it.
** For example, if the player's first [Search] is a Relic, the Elite will not drop a Relic when it is defeated.
** This is also the reason why this specific Elite fight can drop 30 extra Gold compared to a normal Elite; because the 30 Gold [Search] reward is added to the normal Gold reward of defeating an Elite.
* Each subsequent [Search] increases the chance to encounter an Elite by 25%.
* If the player manages to successfully [Search] three times without encountering an Elite, the event will end with a short dialogue detailing the success.
* For the second and third searches (assuming the player is not ambushed), [Search] will be called [Continue] instead. Its behavior and description are unchanged.
options.asc_notes: Find Loot. 25% (35%) (A15): monster returns.

options.label: Leave
options.result: Nothing happens.

events.text:
You come across a dead adventurer on the floor. 
His pants have been stolen! Also, (phrasing depends on the Elite). 
Though his possessions are still intact, you're in no mind to find out what happened here...

combat.monsters: 随机 Act 1 精英：Gremlin Nob / 3× Sentry / Lagavulin（本事件中 Lagavulin 不睡眠且第一回合直接 Siphon Soul，wiki：particular case of different elite behavior）
combat.post_rewards: 精英常规战利品；此前 [Search] 已获得的奖励会从战利品中扣除（金币/遗物各算一次）

events.intro: Dead Adventurer is an Event found exclusively in Act 1.
events.notes:
* Black Star will not cause the Elite to drop an additional Relic. However, the other "elite relics" Preserved Insect, Sling of Courage, and Slaver's Collar will work as expected.
* It is quite unlikely for the player to be able to [Search] three times without being ambushed since they must succeed on all three searches with increasing chances of failure. See the table below for more information:
wiki 概率表（Cumulative Chance of Avoiding the Elite，A15 前/A15 起）：1 次搜索（精英出现率 25%/35%）：避开率 75%/65%；2 次（50%/60%）：37.5%/26%；3 次（75%/85%）：9.375%/3.9%。

"No, no way. Nope. Can't let you in!" 
A man with ridiculous clothing appears at the entrance to bar you.

events.name: Face Trader

options.label: Touch
options.result:
Lose X HP, gain 75 (50) (A15) Gold.
* X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP, rounded down.
options.asc_notes: Lose X HP, gain 75 (50) (A15) Gold.

options.label: Trade
options.result:
50%: Good Face. 50%: Bad Face.
* Receive one of the following special Relics:
** Face of Cleric (good face)
** Ssserpent Head (good face)

You walk by an eerie statue holding several masks... 
Something behind you softly whispers, 
"Stop."

events.notes:
* The chances stated by the Event are inaccurate. The actual chances are 40% good face, 40% bad face, and 20% neutral face (Cultist Headpiece).
** All 5 masks have the same probability of being chosen.

events.name: Falling

options.label: Land
options.result:
Lose (a random Skill)
* Cannot be a Skill targeted by Bottled Lightning.

options.label: Channel
options.result:
Lose (a random Power)
* Cannot be a Power targeted by Bottled Tornado.

options.label: Strike
options.result:
Lose (a random Attack)

If the player somehow manages to lack even a single eligible card (e.g. they have a very small deck containing only bottled cards), then the only option listed is a special [Land] option that has no description.

events.intro: Falling is an Event found exclusively in Act 3.
events.options_preamble: All options will randomly choose a card in the player's deck of a particular type. The option's text will explicitly tell the player which card they would lose. If the player lacks a card of a particular type, then the option relating to that type will be locked (e.g. if the player has no Powers for the [Channel] option, it is replaced with the option [Locked] Requires: Power Card).

Become Cursed -Decay.

In front of you sits an altar to a forgotten god.
Atop the altar sits an ornate female statue with arms outstretched.
She calls out to you, demanding sacrifice.

events.notes:

You come across an inconspicuous pedestal with a shining gold idol sitting peacefully atop. It looks incredibly valuable. 
You sure don't see any traps nearby.

Anger the Mushrooms.

You enter a corridor full of hypnotizing colored mushrooms.
Due to your lack of specialization in mycology you are unable to identify the specimens.
You want to escape, but feel oddly compelled to eat a mushroom...

events.intro: Hypnotizing Colored Mushrooms is an Event encountered exclusively in Act 1. It will only appear if the player is on floor 7 or above. This Event is the only way to obtain Odd Mushroom.

events.name: Knowing Skull

options.label: A Pick Me Up?
options.result:
Get a Potion. Lose X HP. 
* A random Potion is immediately added to the player's left-most empty potion slot.
* The player is able to select this option even if all their potion slots are full or if they possess Sozu. They still lose HP and this option's HP loss is still increased by 1 even though no potion is obtained.

options.label: Riches?
options.result: Gain 90 Gold. Lose X HP.

options.label: Success?
options.result:
Get a Colorless card. Lose X HP.
* A random Uncommon Colorless card is added to the player's deck.

options.label: How do I leave?
options.result:
Lose X HP.
* This event repeats until this option is chosen.

events.text: You find yourself in an old, decorated chamber. In the center of the room, a large skull sits atop an ornate pedestal. As you approach, the skull bursts into flames and turns to face you.
events.intro: Knowing Skull is a shrine Event found exclusively in Act 2. It will only appear if the player has at least 13 HP; guaranteeing they can select at least 1 option and leave the event without dying.
events.options_preamble: The following options are presented to the player until they decide to leave the event. X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP (minimum of 6 HP) plus the number of times they have chosen that specific option (Lose 6 HP, then Lose 7 HP, then Lose 8 HP, etc.)
events.notes:
* Bloody Idol can greatly increase the number of times the player can choose [Riches?] since they will heal 5 HP every time it gives them Gold.
* Tungsten Rod will reduce the HP lost by 1 every time an option is selected.

Find some Potions!

options.asc_notes: * Opens a rewards menu with three (two (A15)) random Potions. These can be skipped.

events.intro:
Lab is a shrine Event found in all Acts.
Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

You encounter a group of bandits wearing large red masks.

* Although the fight can be quite dangerous and offers a Relic reward, it does not count as an Elite combat for the sake of Preserved Insect, Sling of Courage, Black Star, and Slaver's Collar.

events.intro:
Match and Keep is a shrine Event encountered in all Acts.

events.name: Mind Bloom

options.label: I am War
options.result:
Fight a Boss from Act 1. Obtain a Rare Relic.
* The boss is selected at random. It can be the same boss that the player actually fought in Act 1, or one of the two that they did not encounter.
* In addition to the Boss dropping a Rare Relic, it also drops normal combat rewards and 50 (25) (A15) Gold.
options.asc_notes: * In addition to the Boss dropping a Rare Relic, it also drops normal combat rewards and 50 (25) (A15) Gold.

options.label: I am Awake
options.result:
Upgrade all cards. You can no longer heal.
* Obtain Mark of the Bloom.

options.label: I am Rich
options.result:
Gain 999 Gold. Cursed - 2 Normality.
* This option only appears on floors 35 to 40.

options.label: I am Healthy
options.result:
Heal to full HP. Cursed - Doubt.
* This option replaces [I am Rich] on floor 41 and above.

events.text:
While walking and traversing through the chaos of the Spire, your thoughts suddenly begin to feel very... real... 
Imaginings of monsters and riches begin to manifest themselves into reality. 
The sensation is quickly fleeting. What do you do?

combat.monsters: [I am War] 随机 Act 1 Boss（可能是本局实际交战过或未遇到的任意一只）
combat.post_rewards: Rare 遗物 + 常规战斗奖励 + 50（A15: 25）金币

events.intro: Mind Bloom is an Event found exclusively in Act 3. It is one of the events affected by Ascension A15.
events.notes:
* Because the healing prevention of [I am Awake] is implemented as the Mark of the Bloom relic, it can disqualify the player from the Who Needs Relics? achievement.
* The boss fight from [I am War] will trigger Pantograph and Slaver's Collar as if it were a normal end-of-Act boss fight.
* Omamori can prevent one or both Normality curses from [I am Rich] if it has one or both uses remaining. This allows the player to receive 999 Gold with practically no downside, especially considering that Mind Bloom is often one of the last opportunities to encounter Curses in a run.

options.label: Open Sphere

options.label: Leave

Jutting from the chaotic terrain around you, a bony sphere surrounds a mysterious glowing object within. 
While you are curious what lies inside, you notice some sentries keeping an eye on it.

options.label: Offer: Relic B

options.label: Leave

An odd creature with a hunched back sprouting several tentacles is scrounging through a pile of trash and debris in front of you. As you approach, he shuffles towards you in a non-threatening manner.
"N'loth hungry. Feed N'loth."
events.intro: N'loth is a shrine Event found exclusively in Act 2. It will only appear if the player has at least 2 Relics. This Event is the only way to obtain N'loth's Gift.
events.options_preamble: Note: "Relic A" and "Relic B" will be randomly chosen from the player's currently held Relics.

** For example, offering Relics like Mango or Old Coin will not remove the max HP or Gold granted by them, effectively removing the downside of N'loth's Gift.

（随机其一）

events.intro:
Neow is a large whale-like creature with light blue skin and 6 bright yellow eyes. Neow lies at the foot of the Spire and welcomes the player at the beginning of every run.
Neow blesses you based on the success of your previous run, offering Gold, Relics, or Cards, unless you did not reach the Boss of the Exordium, in which case she only offers two options instead of the usual four.
events.notes: Neow 为局首事件（Act 0，非未知层事件）。祝福按上局成绩分两档：未到 Act 1 Boss 只给两项固定祝福；到达过则四祝福按 First/Second/Third/Fourth 依次选择。数值原文含 A6/A14 进阶档。

events.name: Old Beggar

events.intro: The Colosseum is an Event found exclusively in Act 2. It is one of the events affected by Ascension A15. It only appears after the guaranteed Treasure Room on the 6th floor of the City.
events.notes:
Some mechanics behave strangely during the two fights in this event due to their atypical nature:
* [Fight] is treated as a normal combat.
** Smoke Bomb can be used to escape the fight and the player will still be prompted to choose either [COWARDICE] or [VICTORY] afterwards as normal.
** The game still rolls to drop a Potion, but never presents the player with it even if a Potion would be dropped. This means it is impossible to know if the potion chance has increased or decreased, and this uncertainty will persist until the potion chance resets at start of the next act.
** While it has no combat rewards and transitions to the next dialogue of the event very quickly, end-of-combat effects like Burning Blood and Self Repair will still trigger.
* [VICTORY] is treated as an Elite combat for most effects.
** Preserved Insect, Sling of Courage, and Slaver's Collar will all trigger their effects as expected.
** The only exception is Black Star, which has no effect on the Relics dropped as rewards. This combat will always drop exactly 1 Rare Relic and 1 Uncommon Relic.

options.label: Owner

events.text:
As you make your way through the large buildings you come across a long narrow bridge and spot knights on either side, facing one another. 
You approach... 
"HALT!" 
A knight forcefully gestures you to stop with its giant lance.
events.intro: The Joust is a shrine Event found in Act 2. This event can only be encountered with more than 50 Gold.
events.notes:
* If the player possesses Ectoplasm, this event is a mandatory loss of 50 Gold. There is no option to leave the event without betting, and any potential winnings cannot be gained.
* The player may consider using the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value expected value] (EV) of each option to determine who they want to bet on.
** The EV of betting on the Murderer is a net increase of 20 Gold (a 70% chance to receive 100 Gold is an expected 70 Gold, minus the 50 Gold that was bet. 0.7 x 100 - 50 = 20)
** The EV of betting on the Owner is a net increase of 25 Gold (a 30% chance to receive 250 Gold is an expected 75 Gold, minus the 50 Gold that was bet. 0.3 x 250 - 50 = 25)
** It may be more beneficial to ignore the EV and instead consider whether the relatively safe 50 extra Gold by betting on the Murderer is more useful to the player's current run compared to risking the bet on the Owner and likely losing their 50 Gold for the more unlikely net gain of 200 Gold.

* The 333 Gold from [Offer: Golden Idol] easily outperforms any remaining Gold the player could gain from combats by keeping the Golden Idol, especially since they likely do not have many combats left in the run by the time they reach this Act 3 event.

events.intro: Wing Statue is an Event found in Act 1.
events.notes:
The event specifically only checks Attack cards in the player's deck, despite only stating "Cards" in general. It also only checks whether the card's base damage is 10 or more. This means that any card that can only achieve 10 or more damage through the use of multi-hits (such as Twin Strike and Riddle with Holes) or that have damage which is dynamically calculated from certain conditions in combat (such as Perfected Strike and Mind Blast) do not meet the requirement.
